articles.title: New release of LLM adds support for reasoning traces, OpenAI Responses, server-side tools, and smarter logging
articles.description: I released LLM 0.32 this morning, the most significant new version of LLM since the initial launch of the project. articles.title: Prevent cognitive debt by manually retyping LLM-generated code
articles.description: Ankur Sethi argues that manually retyping LLM-generated code is a practical way to avoid cognitive debt. It slows you down, but helps you understand the code, catch bad suggestions, and keep a strong mental model of your codebase. Read more

articles.title: Don't be a meat proxy
articles.description: Don't be a meat proxy Niklas Gruhn coins an excellent new term - meat proxy - for people who blindly copy and paste the output of AI systems to their peers. By all means, prompt AI. But don't just relay the output. Read it, understand it, validate it, and then write a response in your own words (a decent certificate that you've done the prior steps). Making that effort is value you can add. Via Lobste.rs Tags: definitions, ai, generative-ai, llms, ai-misuse
